digest.component_or_area: example skills TDD standard and code-review tests criterion
propositions: The three example skills (rebar-brainstorm, rebar-debug, rebar-implement) lack a shared TDD test-design standard covering test-tier selection, coverage inventory, and fault-realism rules before test authoring.
rebar-debug and rebar-implement specify RED-first and held-out oracle discipline but do not guide how to choose the right test or validate it gates CI.
Code-review tests criterion is missing detection of two antipatterns: non-gating tests and unrealistic fault injection (sleep-only race synchronization).

A canonical shared test-design.md must be created, integrated into all three skill SKILL.md files, rebar-debug's llm-behavioral-taxonomy.md, and the examples README, with per-skill byte-identical copies gated by a unit test.
The code-review tests criterion and eval suite must be extended with the two antipatterns, each with explicit false-positive guards and paired recall + no-fire eval coverage.
Held-out discipline (fix/implementation subagent never sees held-out test code) and plan_review_E5.md must remain untouched across both Gerrit changes.
